title: Econometrics REITInflationPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the REIT-Inflation Panel econometric analysis. The analysis examined the relationship between quarterly REIT index returns and inflation using multiple statistical methods including correlation analysis, OLS regression, VAR modeling, Granger causality tests, and regime analysis. Key findings: (1) Strong positive correlation of 0.93 between inflation and REIT returns; (2) Inflation explains 86.6% of REIT return variation; (3) A 1% increase in inflation is associated with 0.16% increase in REIT returns; (4) REIT returns are significantly higher in high-inflation regimes (0.52% vs 0.25% in low-inflation regimes). The comprehensive report with 10 figures and policy implications has been delivered to report/report.md.
